summary: Mistral released a patch update (v2.24.5) to its mistral-vibe CLI tool adding fuzzy search for MCP servers/connectors, faster startup, and several bug fixes.

practices.reason: Bug fixes to connection pooling and trust-prompt behavior are minor interface changes a team integrating the CLI would want to note but require no immediate action.
practices.quote: Retried Mistral responses are released back into the connection pool
